name: Construire APK Wells Pad

on:
  push:
    branches: ['**']
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  apk:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 21

      - name: Creer le projet Android
        run: |
          set -e
          if [ ! -f index.html ]; then
            for z in *.zip; do
              [ -f "$z" ] && unzip -o "$z" -d _depot
            done
          fi
          IDX=$(find . -name index.html -not -path "./node_modules/*" | head -1)
          if [ -z "$IDX" ]; then
            echo "index.html introuvable dans le depot"
            exit 1
          fi
          SRCDIR=$(dirname "$IDX")
          echo "Fichiers trouves dans $SRCDIR"
          [ "$SRCDIR" = "." ] || cp "$SRCDIR"/icon*.png . 2>/dev/null || true
          mkdir www
          cp "$SRCDIR"/index.html www/
          cp "$SRCDIR"/manifest.webmanifest "$SRCDIR"/service-worker.js www/ 2>/dev/null || true
          cp "$SRCDIR"/icon-*.png www/ 2>/dev/null || true
          npm init -y
          npm install @capacitor/core@7 @capacitor/cli@7 @capacitor/android@7
          npx cap init "Wells Pad" com.wells.pad --web-dir www
          npx cap add android

      - name: Mettre le logo Wells Pad comme icone
        run: |
          set -e
          SRC=icon.png
          [ -f "$SRC" ] || SRC=icon-512.png
          RES=android/app/src/main/res
          sed -i 's/#FFFFFF/#050B1C/I' $RES/values/ic_launcher_background.xml
          for d in mdpi:48:108 hdpi:72:162 xhdpi:96:216 xxhdpi:144:324 xxxhdpi:192:432; do
            IFS=: read name s f <<< "$d"
            convert "$SRC" -resize ${s}x${s} $RES/mipmap-$name/ic_launcher.png
            cp $RES/mipmap-$name/ic_launcher.png $RES/mipmap-$name/ic_launcher_round.png
            g=$((f*66/100))
            convert "$SRC" -resize ${g}x${g} -background none -gravity center -extent ${f}x${f} $RES/mipmap-$name/ic_launcher_foreground.png
          done

      - name: Compiler l APK
        run: |
          set -e
          npx cap sync android
          cd android
          chmod +x gradlew
          ./gradlew assembleDebug
          cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../Wells-Pad.apk

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Wells-Pad-APK
          path: Wells-Pad.apk

      - uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: apk-${{ github.run_number }}
          name: Wells Pad APK ${{ github.run_number }}
          files: Wells-Pad.apk
